title: Correctness of binary multiplication columns
statement: Let $a,b,c$ be finite bit strings with $|c|\le |a|+|b|$. Define the column sum $C_j(a,b)=\sum_{p=0}^{|a|-1}[p\le j]a_p b_{j-p}$ and carries by $K_0=0$ and $K_{j+1}=\lfloor(K_j+C_j(a,b))/2\rfloor$, taking out-of-range bits to be zero. Then $V(c)=V(a)V(b)$ if and only if $K_{|a|+|b|}=0$ and, for every $j<|a|+|b|$, the $j$th bit of $c$ equals $(K_j+C_j(a,b))$ modulo $2$.
